FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: "DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS": "At A/V Solutions Depot, we specialize in the retail sales and rental of high-quality audio and visual equipment, including televisions, amplifiers, and professional lighting systems. Our operations include providing exceptional customer service in our dedicated showroom, offering expert installation and repair services carried out by certified technicians, and renting out well-maintained A/V equipment for events such as weddings and corporate functions. We ensure that all products are rigorously tested and maintained to minimize malfunction risks, and we utilize inventory management systems to efficiently track stock and sales. Our commitment to compliance includes adhering to stringent operational guidelines and maintaining all necessary licenses and insurance, thereby ensuring a reliable and professional service experience for our customers.\n\nCompliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any video rental operations and confirms that we have a central station alarm system. We also have contents insured at Actual Cash Value (ACV) and are subject to a property damage deductible of $500, as these conditions apply to our audio and visual equipment sales and service operations."
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: A/V Rental Innovations LLC, specializing in mobile A/V equipment rentals for corporate events and private parties.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 5, 2023, a delivery truck carrying A/V equipment was involved in a minor accident resulting in the damage of several items, including microphones and projectors, amounting to $1,200. The claim has been processed and is currently closed.
